about: Ready-made game parts, first built for PonsStars and made general: each is a panel with its hooks, states (the shared state names), slots and tokens ready. Paths are relative to this file. Add one to a site with: npm run kit:part -- <part> <site folder> (it copies the files, the tokens and the slots, and prints the markup to paste). See BUILDER-RULES.md, rule 30.

parts.name: scoreboard
parts.label: Scoreboard
parts.about: One row per player or team, leader marked, scores written by a format slot and coloured by sign.

parts.name: action-grid
parts.label: Buy and sell buttons
parts.about: Two rows of amount buttons (buy and sell, or any two opposite actions), each with a shortcut key slot and a click sound slot.

parts.name: countdown
parts.label: Countdown
parts.about: Minutes and seconds to zero; turns to its warning state in the last seconds (a number slot) and ticks (a sound slot).

parts.name: screen
parts.label: TV screen
parts.about: A frame with a glow round anything that plays, static while it loads, a volume knob for the page's sounds and a channel knob.

parts.name: markers
parts.label: Duel circles
parts.about: Two circles placed by position over a chart or field, and a level line (break-even or target) whose look is a line slot.
parts.from: PonsStars' duel circles and break-even line
parts.use: placeMarkers({ x, y }, { x, y }, levelY)
